LanguageData.HE_Pars_Spear.label: immortal's spear
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Spear.description: A long spear of cornel wood with a broad leaf blade and a silver pomegranate on the butt, carried upright on parade and levelled in battle.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Spear.tools.0.label: butt
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Spear.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Akinakes.label: akinakes
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Akinakes.description: A short straight sword with a heart-shaped guard and a pommel of two griffin heads. Quick in a press and worn by every guard officer.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Akinakes.tools.0.label: pommel
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Akinakes.tools.1.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Akinakes.tools.2.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Bow.label: recurve bow
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Bow.description: A short, deeply recurved bow of horn and sinew with lacquered red limbs. Fast to draw and light enough to shoot from a galloping horse.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Bow.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Jezail.label: jezail
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Jezail.description: A very long flintlock with a curved, bone-inlaid stock. It takes an age to reload, but a patient shooter can hit a man across a valley.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Jezail.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Jezail.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Shamshir.label: shamshir
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Shamshir.description: A deeply curved sabre of watered steel. It draws its cut through the target like a lion's claw and is the pride of every Parsian rider.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Shamshir.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Shamshir.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Shamshir.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Rifle.label: Persian rifle
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Rifle.description: A bolt rifle whose stock is inlaid in khatam, thousands of tiny stars of bone, brass and wood. A treasure that also shoots, and the longest-ranged rifle of the nations.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Rifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Rifle.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Pars_LongRifle.label: Persian long rifle
LanguageData.HE_Pars_LongRifle.description: A very long rifle with a khatam-inlaid stock and a fine brass sight. It is slow to aim, and it reaches further than any other gun of the nations.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_LongRifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Pars_LongRifle.tools.1.label: barrel
